node.title: Re: Installing Net::SCP::Expect - it can't find/install Expect
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
[mod://Net::SCP::Expect] was last released over 10 years ago... nowadays, for *NIX systems, I can very much recommend [mod://Net::OpenSSH].

Also, although using the regular CPAN client like you showed is fine, I think [mod://App::cpanminus] (cpanm) is also nicer.
